name: Toes to Bar
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, straight arms, and your legs extended straight together.
Press down slightly through your lats and brace your abs tightly as you sweep your straight legs upward in front of your torso.
Continue curling your pelvis upward until your toes touch or closely approach the bar between your hands.
Lower your legs slowly back down to a controlled dead hang without letting your body swing wildly.
tips: Press down actively on the bar with straight arms to lean your upper torso slightly back as your feet rise.
Control the descent smoothly rather than dropping your legs quickly into an uncontrolled swing.
